content.text_en: 5-Amino-1MQ (5-amino-1-methylquinolinium) is a small synthetic molecule from the quinolinium class, not a peptide chain. Its main use in the scientific literature is as a selective inhibitor of NNMT, an enzyme that transfers a methyl group onto nicotinamide. Reference suppliers describe it as blocking NNMT in cell-based assays without affecting related methyltransferases or the enzymes of the NAD+ salvage pathway, and it has been studied in mouse models. We found no published human trials. Those findings describe specific experimental systems. They say nothing about what this vial will do and are not an expected result. The compound is usually supplied as a salt. Reference-grade material, for example, is sold as the iodide salt, and the salt adds weight: about 1.89 mg of that iodide salt carries 1 mg of the active compound. That’s why the certificate should state which form is in the vial and whether “5 mg” refers to the salt or the free compound. For laboratory research use only. Not for human or veterinary use.

content.text_en: AICAR (acadesine) is a nucleoside analog: a small molecule made of an imidazole base attached to a ribose sugar. content.text_en: DSIP 10mg contains Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide, also known as emideltide, supplied in a lyophilized powder form for controlled laboratory research. DSIP is a synthetic nonapeptide composed of nine amino acids and is commonly represented by the sequence Trp-Ala-Gly-Gly-Asp-Ala-Ser-Gly-Glu. Its compact structure has made it a subject of experimental research involving neurological signaling, sleep-associated processes, and biological rhythm regulation.
content.text_es: DSIP 10mg contiene Péptido Inductor del Sueño Delta, también conocido como emideltida, suministrado en forma de polvo liofilizado para investigación controlada en laboratorio. El DSIP es un nonapéptido sintético compuesto por nueve aminoácidos y se representa comúnmente por la secuencia Trp-Ala-Gly-Gly-Asp-Ala-Ser-Gly-Glu. Su estructura compacta lo ha convertido en objeto de investigación experimental relacionada con la señalización neurológica, los procesos asociados al sueño y la regulación de los ritmos biológicos.

content.text_en: Research interest in DSIP initially developed around its potential relationship with delta-wave sleep and sleep-onset mechanisms. Laboratory and early experimental studies have examined its possible influence on sleep latency, slow-wave activity, circadian patterns, and physiological processes associated with rest. However, later scientific reviews have noted that DSIP’s exact biological role and relationship with sleep remain incompletely characterized.
content.text_es: El interés en la investigación sobre DSIP se desarrolló inicialmente en torno a su posible relación con las ondas delta del sueño y los mecanismos de inicio del mismo. Estudios de laboratorio y experimentales iniciales examinaron su posible influencia en la latencia del sueño, la actividad de ondas lentas, los patrones circadianos y los procesos fisiológicos asociados con el descanso. Sin embargo, revisiones científicas posteriores han señalado que el papel biológico exacto y la relación del DSIP con el sueño siguen estando incompletamente caracterizados.

content.text_en: Beyond sleep-related research, DSIP has also been investigated in experimental models involving neurotransmitter activity, stress responses, hormonal signaling, thermoregulation, and other physiological pathways. These areas remain exploratory, and reported findings can vary depending on the research model, study conditions, and methods used. DSIP should therefore be treated as an experimental research material rather than a clinically established sleep or therapeutic compound.
content.text_es: Más allá de la investigación relacionada con el sueño, el DSIP también ha sido investigado en modelos experimentales que involucran la actividad de neurotransmisores, las respuestas al estrés, la señalización hormonal, la termorregulación y otras vías fisiológicas. Estas áreas siguen siendo exploratorias y los hallazgos reportados pueden variar según el modelo de investigación, las condiciones del estudio y los métodos utilizados. Por lo tanto, el DSIP debe tratarse como un material de investigación experimental en lugar de un compuesto terapéutico o para el sueño clínicamente establecido.

content.text_en: Epithalon (also spelled Epitalon) is a synthetic peptide of four amino acids: Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly, often shortened to AEDG. It was developed at the St. Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology in Russia as a simplified synthetic counterpart to epithalamin, a peptide preparation from the pineal gland.
content.text_es: Epithalon (also spelled Epitalon) is a synthetic peptide of four amino acids: Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly, often shortened to AEDG. It was developed at the St. Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology in Russia as a simplified synthetic counterpart to epithalamin, a peptide preparation from the pineal gland.

content.text_en: Its best-known research finding comes from cell culture. In a 2003 study, adding Epithalon to human fetal fibroblasts that lacked telomerase activity induced expression of the enzyme’s catalytic subunit, telomerase activity and telomere elongation. Telomerase is the enzyme that maintains telomeres, the protective ends of chromosomes. An independent 2025 study reported telomere lengthening in several human cell lines, through telomerase in normal cells and through a different mechanism in cancer cell lines.

content.text_en: GHK-Cu (Glycyl-L-Histidyl-L-Lysine Copper) is a naturally occurring peptide complex that binds with copper ions and plays an important role in tissue repair and regeneration. It is found in small amounts in human plasma and is known to decline with age, which has led to increased interest in its supplementation for skin and cellular health.

Se encuentra en pequeñas cantidades en el plasma humano y se sabe que disminuye con la edad, lo que ha generado un creciente interés en su suplementación para la salud de la piel y celular.

content.text_en: One of its primary functions is its involvement in wound healing and tissue remodeling, where it helps support the production of structural proteins such as collagen and elastin. These proteins are essential for maintaining skin firmness, elasticity, and overall integrity.
content.text_es: Una de sus funciones principales es su participación en la curación de heridas y la remodelación de tejidos, donde ayuda a respaldar la producción de proteínas estructurales como el colágeno y la elastina. Estas proteínas son esenciales para mantener la firmeza, elasticidad e integridad general de la piel.

content.text_en: GHK-Cu is also associated with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity, helping reduce oxidative stress and support cellular protection. Additionally, it plays a role in signaling pathways that promote cellular repair and regeneration.
content.text_es: El GHK-Cu también se asocia con actividad antiinflamatoria y antioxidante, ayudando a reducir el estrés oxidativo y a respaldar la protección celular. Adicionalmente, desempeña un papel en las vías de señalización que promueven la reparación y regeneración celular.

content.text_en: Its ability to support both skin health and broader cellular recovery processes makes GHK-Cu a versatile peptide used in aesthetic, wellness, and recovery-focused protocols.
content.text_es: Su capacidad para respaldar tanto la salud de la piel como los procesos de recuperación celular más amplios hace del GHK-Cu un péptido versátil utilizado en protocolos enfocados en estética, bienestar y recuperación.

content.text_en: GLP-1 is an advanced multi-agonist peptide studied for its interaction with three key metabolic receptor systems: GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. Most peptides in this research area act on one receptor. content.text_es: GLP-1 is an advanced multi-agonist peptide studied for its interaction with three key metabolic receptor systems: GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. Most peptides in this research area act on one receptor. The compound in this vial, was designed to act on three: the glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R), the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor (GIPR) and the glucagon receptor (GCGR).

content.text_en: It doesn’t act on all three equally. In cell-based assays it is most potent at GIPR, then GLP-1R, and least potent at GCGR. Compared with the body’s own hormones, it is weaker than native GLP-1 and glucagon at their receptors but stronger than native GIP at the GIP receptor. That uneven profile is what makes it interesting as a research tool.

content.text_en: Structurally, hCG has two subunits. The alpha subunit (92 amino acids) is shared with the other hormones in its family. The beta subunit (145 amino acids) is specific to hCG. About a third of its weight is carbohydrate, and its molecular mass is roughly 37 kDa, varying with glycosylation.

content.text_en: IGF-1 LR3 (Long R3 IGF-1) is a modified form of human insulin-like growth factor-1. It differs from natural IGF-1 in two ways: the glutamic acid at position 3 is replaced by arginine (the “R3”), and a 13-amino-acid extension is added at the start of the chain (the “Long”), bringing it to 83 amino acids. The extension is derived from the start of porcine growth hormone.
content.text_es: IGF-1 LR3 (Long R3 IGF-1) is a modified form of human insulin-like growth factor-1. It differs from natural IGF-1 in two ways: the glutamic acid at position 3 is replaced by arginine (the “R3”), and a 13-amino-acid extension is added at the start of the chain (the “Long”), bringing it to 83 amino acids. The extension is derived from the start of porcine growth hormone.

content.text_en: These changes greatly reduce how strongly the protein binds to IGF-binding proteins, which normally hold IGF-1 back from acting. That is why IGF-1 LR3 is more potent than natural IGF-1 in cell culture, where those binding proteins are present.

content.text_es: El Kisspeptin-10 es los diez últimos aminoácidos del Kisspeptin, un péptido codificado por el gen KISS1. También se conoce como metastin (45-54), ya que el péptido progenitor más largo fue descrito por primera vez como “metastin” en la investigación sobre el cáncer.

content.text_en: MOTS-C is a 16-amino-acid peptide encoded within mitochondrial DNA. Mitochondria play a central role in cellular energy production, and MOTS-C has gained attention for its potential influence on metabolic signaling and energy-sensing pathways. Research suggests MOTS-C may interact with AMPK, a pathway involved in how cells respond to energy demand, glucose availability, and metabolic stress.
content.text_es: MOTS-C es un péptido de 16 aminoácidos codificado dentro del ADN mitocondrial. Las mitocondrias desempeñan un papel central en la producción de energía celular, y MOTS-C ha ganado atención por su posible influencia en las vías de señalización metabólica y de detección de energía. La investigación sugiere que MOTS-C podría interactuar con AMPK, una vía involucrada en cómo las células responden a la demanda de energía, la disponibilidad de glucosa y el estrés metabólico.

content.text_en: Unlike peptides that are mainly associated with repair, skin, or recovery, MOTS-C is more closely connected to cellular metabolism and mitochondrial communication. It has been studied for its relationship with skeletal muscle metabolism, exercise adaptation, insulin sensitivity, and age-related metabolic changes, mostly in preclinical and early research settings.
content.text_es: A diferencia de los péptidos que se asocian principalmente con la reparación, la piel o la recuperación, el MOTS-C está más estrechamente relacionado con el metabolismo celular y la comunicación mitocondrial. Se ha estudiado por su relación con el metabolismo del músculo esquelético, la adaptación al ejercicio, la sensibilidad a la insulina y los cambios metabólicos relacionados con la edad, principalmente en entornos de investigación preclínica y temprana.

content.text_en: MT-II, commonly referred to as Melanotan II, is a synthetic peptide researched for its relationship with melanocortin receptor pathways. content.text_en: In the laboratory, NAD+ is one of the most widely used reagents in biochemistry. That makes it a routine component of enzyme assays and cell-metabolism experiments.

content.text_en: Selank is a synthetic heptapeptide derived from the naturally occurring immunomodulatory peptide tuftsin. It was developed by Russian researchers as a novel anxiolytic compound designed to deliver calming, mood-stabilizing benefits without the drawbacks commonly associated with traditional benzodiazepines — such as drowsiness, cognitive dulling, or dependency.

Fue desarrollado por investigadores rusos como un nuevo compuesto ansiolítico diseñado para brindar beneficios calmantes y estabilizadores del estado de ánimo sin los inconvenientes comúnmente asociados con las benzodiacepinas tradicionales, como somnolencia, enturbiamiento cognitivo o dependencia.

content.text_en: Selank exerts its effects primarily through modulation of GABA, serotonin, and dopamine pathways, which together regulate mood, anxiety response, and emotional balance. By influencing these neurotransmitters, it helps reduce feelings of stress and tension while simultaneously supporting clearer thinking and improved focus. Unlike sedating compounds, Selank delivers a state of relaxed alertness — ideal for high-pressure environments.
content.text_es: Selank ejerce sus efectos principalmente a través de la modulación de las vías de GABA, serotonina y dopamina, que juntas regulan el estado de ánimo, la respuesta a la ansiedad y el equilibrio emocional. Al influir en estos neurotransmisores, ayuda a reducir los sentimientos de estrés y tensión, al tiempo que apoya un pensamiento más claro y una mejor concentración. A diferencia de los compuestos sedantes, Selank proporciona un estado de alerta relajada, ideal para entornos de alta presión.

content.text_en: Beyond its anxiolytic action, Selank has demonstrated nootropic qualities, enhancing memory, learning capacity, and mental endurance. It also exhibits immunomodulatory effects inherited from its tuftsin lineage, offering subtle support for immune resilience and inflammation control. Some research even suggests benefits for neuroplasticity and BDNF (brain-derived neurotrophic factor) expression, supporting long-term brain health.
content.text_es: Más allá de su acción ansiolítica, Selank ha demostrado cualidades nootrópicas, mejorando la memoria, la capacidad de aprendizaje y la resistencia mental. También exhibe efectos inmunomoduladores heredados de su linaje de tuftsina, ofreciendo un sutil apoyo a la resiliencia inmunológica y al control de la inflamación. Algunas investigaciones incluso sugieren beneficios para la neuroplasticidad y la expresión del BDNF (factor neurotrófico derivado del cerebro), apoyando la salud cerebral a largo plazo.

content.text_en: Sermorelin is a synthetic analog of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH), composed of the first 29 amino acids of the natural GHRH molecule — the shortest sequence still capable of stimulating growth hormone release. This makes it a powerful yet biologically familiar peptide that signals the pituitary gland to produce and release more of its own HGH.

Esto la convierte en un péptido potente y a la vez biológicamente familiar que señala a la glándula pituitaria para que produzca y libere más de su propia HGH.

content.text_en: What sets Sermorelin apart from synthetic HGH injections is its mechanism: rather than flooding the body with external growth hormone, it encourages the pituitary to function more actively. This preserves the body’s natural feedback loops, reducing the risk of shutdown or dependency while delivering smoother, pulsatile HGH release that mirrors youthful hormonal patterns.

Esto preserva los ciclos de retroalimentación naturales del cuerpo, reduciendo el riesgo de supresión o dependencia, al tiempo que proporciona una liberación de HGH más suave y pulsátil que imita los patrones hormonales juveniles.

content.text_en: Increased natural HGH levels translate to a wide range of benefits — improved sleep depth, enhanced muscle recovery, reduced body fat, stronger skin elasticity, better bone density, and renewed energy. Because growth hormone production naturally declines with age, Sermorelin is particularly valued by adults seeking to counteract age-related changes in body composition, vitality, and recovery capacity.
content.text_es: El aumento de los niveles naturales de HGH se traduce en una amplia gama de beneficios: mejora de la profundidad del sueño, mayor recuperación muscular, reducción de la grasa corporal, mayor elasticidad de la piel, mejor densidad ósea y energía renovada. content.text_en: SS-31, also called Elamipretide or MTP-131, is a small synthetic tetrapeptide uniquely engineered to selectively target the mitochondria — the energy-producing organelles within every cell. Se une a la cardiolipina, un fosfolípido crítico que se encuentra exclusivamente en la membrana mitocondrial interna, donde estabiliza la estructura mitocondrial y optimiza la producción de energía.

content.text_en: As mitochondria age or come under stress, cardiolipin becomes damaged, leading to inefficient ATP production, increased oxidative stress, and accelerated cellular decline. SS-31 reverses this dysfunction by protecting cardiolipin, neutralizing reactive oxygen species (ROS), and restoring the mitochondria’s ability to generate clean, efficient energy.

El SS-31 revierte esta disfunción al proteger la cardiolipina, neutralizar las especies reactivas de oxígeno (ROS) y restaurar la capacidad de las mitocondrias para generar energía limpia y eficiente.

content.text_en: This precise mechanism gives SS-31 wide-reaching benefits across multiple body systems. It has shown particular promise in supporting cardiovascular health, including improved heart muscle function, better blood flow, and protection against ischemic injury. SS-31 also supports skeletal muscle performance, neurological wellness, kidney function, and recovery from age-related fatigue and degeneration.
content.text_es: Este mecanismo preciso otorga al SS-31 amplios beneficios en múltiples sistemas del cuerpo. Ha demostrado una promesa particular en el apoyo a la salud cardiovascular, incluida una mejora en la función del músculo cardíaco, un mejor flujo sanguíneo y protección contra lesiones isquémicas. El SS-31 también apoya el rendimiento del músculo esquelético, el bienestar neurológico, la función renal y la recuperación de la fatiga y la degeneración relacionadas con la edad.

content.text_en: Unlike general antioxidants, SS-31 works exactly where energy is made — making it one of the most targeted mitochondrial peptides available today. SS-31 10mg is ideal for individuals focused on longevity, cellular resilience, and high-performance recovery, offering foundational support for the systems that decline most with age.
content.text_es: A diferencia de los antioxidantes generales, SS-31 actúa exactamente donde se genera la energía, lo que lo convierte en uno de los péptidos mitocondriales más específicos disponibles en la actualidad. content.text_en: Thymosin Beta-4 (TB-4) is a naturally occurring 43-amino acid peptide present in nearly all human and animal cells, with particularly high concentrations in platelets and wound fluid. Its central role is to regulate actin — a protein essential for cell structure, movement, and tissue repair — making TB-4 a master orchestrator of the body’s healing response.

Su papel central es regular la actina, una proteína esencial para la estructura, el movimiento y la reparación de los tejidos, lo que convierte a la TB-4 en un orquestador principal de la respuesta curativa del cuerpo.

content.text_en: When tissue is damaged, TB-4 levels rise dramatically at the injury site, where it promotes cell migration, blood vessel formation (angiogenesis), and the recruitment of stem cells to accelerate repair. This unique mechanism allows TB-4 to support healing across a wide range of tissues, including muscle, tendon, ligament, skin, and even cardiac and neural tissue.

Este mecanismo único permite que la TB-4 apoye la curación en una amplia gama de tejidos, incluyendo músculo, tendón, ligamento, piel e incluso tejido cardíaco y neural.

content.text_en: Beyond its regenerative effects, TB-4 demonstrates strong anti-inflammatory properties, helping reduce chronic inflammation that often slows recovery and contributes to long-term tissue degradation. It also supports flexibility, joint mobility, and the breakdown of scar tissue and adhesions — all critical factors for athletes and active individuals.
content.text_es: Más allá de sus efectos regenerativos, la TB-4 demuestra fuertes propiedades antiinflamatorias, ayudando a reducir la inflamación crónica que a menudo ralentiza la recuperación y contribuye a la degradación tisular a largo plazo. También apoya la flexibilidad, la movilidad articular y la degradación del tejido cicatricial y las adherencias, todos factores críticos para atletas y personas activas.

content.text_en: Tesamorelin is a synthetic analog of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH), engineered to stimulate the pituitary gland to produce and release the body’s own human growth hormone (HGH) in a natural, pulsatile manner. What sets Tesamorelin apart from other GHRH peptides is its remarkable specificity for reducing visceral adipose tissue (VAT) — the deep abdominal fat that surrounds internal organs and is strongly linked to cardiovascular and metabolic concerns.
content.text_es: La tesamorelin es un análogo sintético de la hormona liberadora de hormona del crecimiento (GHRH, por sus siglas en inglés), diseñado para estimular la glándula pituitaria a producir y liberar la hormona del crecimiento humano (HGH, por sus siglas en inglés) propia del cuerpo de manera natural y pulsátil. Lo que distingue a la tesamorelin de otros péptidos de GHRH es su notable especificidad para reducir el tejido adiposo visceral (TAV), la grasa abdominal profunda que rodea los órganos internos y está fuertemente relacionada con problemas cardiovasculares y metabólicos.

content.text_en: By preserving the body’s natural feedback loops, Tesamorelin avoids the shutdown risks associated with synthetic HGH while delivering steady, sustained increases in growth hormone levels. This translates to a wide range of benefits: targeted reduction in visceral fat, improved lean muscle mass, healthier cholesterol and triglyceride profiles, and enhanced metabolic markers.
content.text_es: Al conservar los bucles de retroalimentación naturales del cuerpo, Tesamorelin evita los riesgos de interrupción asociados con la HGH sintética, a la vez que proporciona aumentos constantes y sostenidos en los niveles de la hormona del crecimiento. Esto se traduce en una amplia gama de beneficios: reducción específica de la grasa visceral, mejor masa muscular magra, perfiles más saludables de colesterol y triglicéridos, y mejora de los marcadores metabólicos.

content.text_en: Clinical research has highlighted Tesamorelin’s role in improving body composition, particularly in individuals struggling with abdominal fat accumulation that resists diet and exercise alone. It also shows promising effects on cognitive function, particularly memory and processing speed, as well as improvements in skin quality, sleep depth, and overall vitality.
content.text_es: La investigación clínica ha puesto de manifiesto Tesamorelin papel en la mejora de la composición corporal, especialmente en personas con acumulación de grasa abdominal que resiste la dieta y el ejercicio por sí solos. También muestra efectos prometedores en la función cognitiva, particularmente la memoria y la velocidad de procesamiento, así como mejoras en la calidad de la piel, la profundidad del sueño y la vitalidad general.

content.text_en: Tesamorelin 10mg offers a precise, research-validated approach for those seeking targeted fat loss, hormonal optimization, and the deeper anti-aging benefits that come with restoring more youthful HGH activity in the body.

content.text_en: Tesamorelin is a synthetic analog of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH), engineered to stimulate the pituitary gland to produce and release the body’s own human growth hormone (HGH) in a natural, pulsatile manner. What sets Tesamorelin apart from other GHRH peptides is its remarkable specificity for reducing visceral adipose tissue (VAT) — the deep abdominal fat that surrounds internal organs and is strongly linked to cardiovascular and metabolic concerns.

Lo que distingue a la tesamorelin de otros péptidos de GHRH es su notable especificidad para reducir el tejido adiposo visceral (TAV), la grasa abdominal profunda que rodea los órganos internos y que está fuertemente relacionada con problemas cardiovasculares y metabólicos.

content.text_en: By preserving the body’s natural feedback loops, Tesamorelin avoids the shutdown risks associated with synthetic HGH while delivering steady, sustained increases in growth hormone levels. This translates to a wide range of benefits: targeted reduction in visceral fat, improved lean muscle mass, healthier cholesterol and triglyceride profiles, and enhanced metabolic markers.

Esto se traduce en una amplia gama de beneficios: reducción específica de la grasa visceral, mejora de la masa muscular magra, perfiles de colesterol y triglicéridos más saludables y marcadores metabólicos mejorados.

content.text_en: Clinical research has highlighted Tesamorelin’s role in improving body composition, particularly in individuals struggling with abdominal fat accumulation that resists diet and exercise alone. It also shows promising effects on cognitive function, particularly memory and processing speed, as well as improvements in skin quality, sleep depth, and overall vitality.
content.text_es: La investigación clínica ha destacado el papel de la Tesamorelin en la mejora de la composición corporal, en particular en personas que luchan con la acumulación de grasa abdominal que resiste la dieta y el ejercicio por sí solos. También muestra efectos prometedores en la función cognitiva, particularmente en la memoria y la velocidad de procesamiento, así como mejoras en la calidad de la piel, la profundidad del sueño y la vitalidad general.

content.text_en: Tirzepatide is a long-acting, synthetic modified peptide that works as a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist. By activating these two naturally occurring hormone pathways, tirzepatide can help regulate blood-glucose levels, improve the body’s response to insulin, reduce appetite and promote a longer-lasting feeling of fullness. Approved prescription products containing tirzepatide are used alongside appropriate diet and physical activity for blood-sugar management and chronic weight management in eligible patients.
content.text_es: Tirzepatide is a long-acting, synthetic modified peptide that works as a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist. By activating these two naturally occurring hormone pathways, tirzepatide can help regulate blood-glucose levels, improve the body’s response to insulin, reduce appetite and promote a longer-lasting feeling of fullness. Approved prescription products containing tirzepatide are used alongside appropriate diet and physical activity for blood-sugar management and chronic weight management in eligible patients.

content.text_en: Its dual-receptor mechanism distinguishes tirzepatide from medicines that target only the GLP-1 receptor. It supports glucose-dependent insulin release when blood-sugar levels are elevated, reduces inappropriate glucagon secretion and slows gastric emptying. These combined actions may help reduce food intake, improve portion control and support gradual, sustained weight reduction when the medicine is prescribed as part of a professionally supervised treatment plan.
